title: Distant Figure at Dusk
description: A woman with short green-tinted hair and a dark collared coat stands in the foreground, gazing toward the viewer. Behind her stretches a barren, desolate landscape under a muted sunset, with a solitary silhouetted figure standing on a ridge and faint ruined structures visible on the horizon.
